description.zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
description.en: Organization identity, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

description.zh: 资源类型 pipeline 流水线  hostGroup 主机组
description.en: Resource type: pipeline (pipeline) or hostGroup (host group)

description.zh:
角色部署组 hostGroup 

- user 成员，使用权限 

- admin 管理员，使用编辑权限

-  owner 拥有者，所有权限 

流水线 pipeline 

- owner 拥有者，所有权限

- admin  查看、运行、编辑权限

-  member 运行权限 

- viewer 查看权限
description.en:
Role

For deployment group (deployGroup):
- user: member with usage permission  
- admin: administrator with edit permission  
- owner: owner with all permissions  

For pipeline:
- owner: owner with all permissions  
- admin: View, Run, and Edit permissions  
- member: Run permission  
- viewer: View permission
